record.question: The addition of non-nutritious substances to food to improve its appearance, flavour, texture and storage properties is known as:
record.explanation: Answer B: Food additives. Food additives are substances added to food for technological purposes such as improving appearance, flavor, texture, or shelf stability; food adulteration is a distinct safety/legal concept. Reference: https://www.fssai.gov.in/cms/food-safety-and-standards-act.php. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
